text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina got injured during training, so I 
brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't a serious injury, so I will 
return to training now.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
A queen cannot afford to be brought to a 
halt by an injury of this magnitude.
choice_data_list: Overdoing it is a no-go, okay?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your concern. However, as 
you can see, it's not hindering my 
movement much at all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Daily accumulation is the true path to the 
"pinnacle." If so, I wish to keep moving 
forward without pause—
choice_data_list:
…No, let's play it safe and take a break 
here.

In that case, just to be safe, let's start 
with some light exercise.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You're exaggerating! I really didn't do 
anything—...!
choice_data_list:
If you aim for the top, you must ensure 
you're fully prepared.

If you aim for the top, you should make 
sure you're fully prepared.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. If worsening my injury sets me 
back, it would defeat the whole purpose."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I'll stay quiet and rest for 
now...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Trainer. Maybe I took this 
too lightly... ngh!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Geez, what on earth am I doing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina's injury worsened, forcing her to 
take a period of rest...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes! At this pace, I'll gradually get used 
to it!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Thank goodness. With this, surely I 
won't fall behind the others.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, by continuing with lighter 
training, Verxina smoothly made her 
comeback.
